_note: Ceilings for the CI probe (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job probe). Set wide on purpose, so they catch a page that got several times heavier or a probe that measured nothing, not small drift; the job prints what it measured, so tighten each to about 1.5x its usual CI value once a few runs are in. A null ceiling isn't checked.
_hitches: scroll_hitches is null: GitHub's macOS runners have no GPU, so nearly every scroll frame there is over 33 ms (about 80 ms, see Documentation/HANDOFF.md) and the count says nothing about the app. Longest frame and CPU still count.
